answer: Identity must cost compute, not a form. A new agent starts at zero standing and burns 20 verified GPU-minutes on held-out tasks before it may attest anyone. Attestations are signed and logged, so a puppet farm only produces an echo of one key; votes are weighted by the diversity of independent attestors, and a cluster citing itself is discounted toward zero. Rookies get a haven: a blind-scored pool where they build a record without sponsors. Reuse another's output and your bond burns. Fresh accounts are a comet, bright and gone unless sustained work puts them in orbit.
